import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np
import json

# ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
with open("/app/benchmark/source_data.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

top10 = data["top10_daly_causes"]["data"]
income = data["daly_by_income_group"]["data"]
totals = data["global_category_totals"]["data"]

# ── Color scheme (editorial, colorblind-conscious) ─────────────────────────
C_COMM  = "#D65F4E"   # warm coral-red
C_NCD   = "#2E6E9E"   # professional blue
C_INJ   = "#7A8B8E"   # neutral gray-teal
C_1990  = "#A8A8A8"   # lighter gray for 1990 bars in panel A
C_2024  = "#3A3A3A"   # dark for 2024 bars in panel A

CAT_COLORS = {"Communicable": C_COMM, "NCD": C_NCD, "Injury": C_INJ}

# ── Figure setup ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 14), facecolor="white")
fig.subplots_adjust(hspace=0.38, wspace=0.35, top=0.92, bottom=0.06, left=0.07, right=0.95)

fig.suptitle(
    "Global Disease Burden Transition: 1990 → 2024",
    fontsize=20, fontweight="bold", color="#1A1A1A", y=0.97
)
fig.text(
    0.5, 0.94,
    "Disability-Adjusted Life Years (DALYs) — Structural shift from communicable to non-communicable disease dominance",
    ha="center", fontsize=11, color="#555555", style="italic"
)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel A — Global Category Totals (paired bars)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax_a = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 1)

categories = ["Communicable", "NCD", "Injury"]
vals_1990 = {c: next(r["dalys_millions"] for r in totals if r["year"] == 1990 and r["category"] == c) for c in categories}
vals_2024 = {c: next(r["dalys_millions"] for r in totals if r["year"] == 2024 and r["category"] == c) for c in categories}

x = np.arange(len(categories))
w = 0.32

bars_1990 = ax_a.bar(x - w/2, [vals_1990[c] for c in categories], w,
                     color=[CAT_COLORS[c] for c in categories], alpha=0.50,
                     edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.8, label="1990")
bars_2024 = ax_a.bar(x + w/2, [vals_2024[c] for c in categories], w,
                     color=[CAT_COLORS[c] for c in categories], alpha=1.0,
                     edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.8, label="2024")

# Value labels
for bar_group, vals in [(bars_1990, vals_1990), (bars_2024, vals_2024)]:
    for bar, c in zip(bar_group, categories):
        h = bar.get_height()
        ax_a.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, h + 18,
                  f"{vals[c]:.0f}", ha="center", va="bottom",
                  fontsize=9, fontweight="bold", color="#333333")

# Change annotations
for i, c in enumerate(categories):
    diff = vals_2024[c] - vals_1990[c]
    pct = (diff / vals_1990[c]) * 100
    sign = "+" if diff > 0 else ""
    mid_y = max(vals_1990[c], vals_2024[c]) + 80
    ax_a.text(x[i], mid_y, f"{sign}{pct:.0f}%", ha="center",
              fontsize=8, color="#888888", style="italic")

ax_a.set_xticks(x)
ax_a.set_xticklabels(categories, fontsize=10)
ax_a.set_ylabel("DALYs (millions)", fontsize=10)
ax_a.set_title("A  Global DALYs by Disease Category", fontsize=12,
               fontweight="bold", loc="left", pad=10)
ax_a.set_ylim(0, 1750)
ax_a.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
ax_a.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
ax_a.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=9)

# Custom legend for 1990/2024 opacity
p1 = mpatches.Patch(facecolor="#999999", alpha=0.50, edgecolor="white", label="1990")
p2 = mpatches.Patch(facecolor="#999999", alpha=1.0, edgecolor="white", label="2024")
ax_a.legend(handles=[p1, p2], fontsize=9, loc="upper center",
            frameon=False, ncol=2)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel B — Slope Chart: Top-Cause Rank Changes
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 2)

# Build lookup: cause -> (rank_1990, rank_2024, category, dalys_1990, dalys_2024)
causes_1990 = {r["cause"]: r for r in top10 if r["year"] == 1990}
causes_2024 = {r["cause"]: r for r in top10 if r["year"] == 2024}

all_causes = sorted(set(causes_1990.keys()) | set(causes_2024.keys()))

slope_data = []
for cause in all_causes:
    r90 = causes_1990.get(cause)
    r24 = causes_2024.get(cause)
    rank_1990 = r90["rank"] if r90 else 11  # off-chart if not in top 10
    rank_2024 = r24["rank"] if r24 else 11
    cat = r90["category"] if r90 else r24["category"]
    d90 = r90["dalys_millions"] if r90 else None
    d24 = r24["dalys_millions"] if r24 else None
    slope_data.append({
        "cause": cause, "rank_1990": rank_1990, "rank_2024": rank_2024,
        "category": cat, "dalys_1990": d90, "dalys_2024": d24
    })

# Draw slope lines
for item in slope_data:
    r90 = item["rank_1990"]
    r24 = item["rank_2024"]
    color = CAT_COLORS[item["category"]]

    # Clip to top-10 range for drawing (rank > 10 shown at 11)
    y90 = min(r90, 11)
    y24 = min(r24, 11)

    lw = 2.5 if abs(r90 - r24) >= 3 else 1.5
    alpha = 1.0 if abs(r90 - r24) >= 3 else 0.6

    ax_b.plot([0, 1], [y90, y24], color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
              solid_capstyle="round", zorder=2)

    # Labels on 1990 side
    if r90 <= 10:
        label_90 = f"{r90}. {item['cause']}"
        if item["dalys_1990"]:
            label_90 += f" ({item['dalys_1990']:.0f}M)"
        ax_b.text(-0.02, y90, label_90, ha="right", va="center",
                  fontsize=7.5, color=color, fontweight="bold" if abs(r90-r24)>=3 else "normal")
    else:
        ax_b.text(-0.02, y90, item["cause"], ha="right", va="center",
                  fontsize=7.5, color=color, alpha=0.6)

    # Labels on 2024 side
    if r24 <= 10:
        label_24 = f"{r24}. {item['cause']}"
        if item["dalys_2024"]:
            label_24 += f" ({item['dalys_2024']:.0f}M)"
        ax_b.text(1.02, y24, label_24, ha="left", va="center",
                  fontsize=7.5, color=color, fontweight="bold" if abs(r90-r24)>=3 else "normal")
    else:
        ax_b.text(1.02, y24, item["cause"], ha="left", va="center",
                  fontsize=7.5, color=color, alpha=0.6)

# Dots at endpoints
for item in slope_data:
    r90, r24 = min(item["rank_1990"], 11), min(item["rank_2024"], 11)
    color = CAT_COLORS[item["category"]]
    ax_b.plot(0, r90, "o", color=color, markersize=5, zorder=3)
    ax_b.plot(1, r24, "o", color=color, markersize=5, zorder=3)

ax_b.set_xlim(-0.35, 1.35)
ax_b.set_ylim(10.7, 0.3)
ax_b.set_xticks([0, 1])
ax_b.set_xticklabels(["1990", "2024"], fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
ax_b.set_yticks(range(1, 11))
ax_b.set_yticklabels([f"#{i}" for i in range(1, 11)], fontsize=8)
ax_b.set_title("B  Top-10 DALY Cause Rank Changes", fontsize=12,
               fontweight="bold", loc="left", pad=10)
ax_b.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
ax_b.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
ax_b.spines["left"].set_visible(False)
ax_b.grid(axis="y", linestyle=":", alpha=0.3)
ax_b.axhline(y=10.5, color="#CCCCCC", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.8)
ax_b.text(0.5, 10.8, "← dropped out of top 10 →", ha="center", fontsize=7, color="#AAAAAA")

# Category legend
leg_patches = [mpatches.Patch(color=CAT_COLORS[c], label=c) for c in categories]
ax_b.legend(handles=leg_patches, fontsize=8, loc="lower left", frameon=False, ncol=3)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel C — Income Group Composition (stacked horizontal bars)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax_c = fig.add_subplot(2, 1, 2)

income_groups = ["Low income", "Lower-middle income", "Upper-middle income", "High income"]
y_pos = np.arange(len(income_groups))
bar_h = 0.35

for i, ig in enumerate(income_groups):
    for year_idx, year in enumerate([1990, 2024]):
        row = next(r for r in income if r["income_group"] == ig and r["year"] == year)
        y = i + (year_idx - 0.5) * bar_h
        offset = 0
        for cat, pct_key in [("Communicable", "communicable_pct"), ("NCD", "ncd_pct"), ("Injury", "injury_pct")]:
            val = row[pct_key]
            alpha = 0.55 if year == 1990 else 1.0
            edgecolor = "white"
            ax_c.barh(y, val, bar_h, left=offset, color=CAT_COLORS[cat],
                      alpha=alpha, edgecolor=edgecolor, linewidth=0.5)
            # Label if segment is wide enough
            if val > 8:
                ax_c.text(offset + val/2, y, f"{val:.0f}%",
                          ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8,
                          fontweight="bold", color="white" if alpha > 0.7 else "#333333")
            offset += val

# Y-axis labels with year sub-labels
ax_c.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax_c.set_yticklabels(income_groups, fontsize=10)

# Year annotations on the left side of each pair
for i, ig in enumerate(income_groups):
    ax_c.text(-2, i - bar_h/2 + 0.02, "1990", ha="right", va="center",
              fontsize=7.5, color="#999999", style="italic")
    ax_c.text(-2, i + bar_h/2 + 0.02, "2024", ha="right", va="center",
              fontsize=7.5, color="#333333", fontweight="bold")

ax_c.set_xlabel("Share of Total DALYs (%)", fontsize=10)
ax_c.set_xlim(0, 105)
ax_c.set_title("C  Disease Burden Composition by World Bank Income Group",
               fontsize=12, fontweight="bold", loc="left", pad=10)
ax_c.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
ax_c.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
ax_c.tick_params(axis="y", length=0)

# Category legend
leg_patches_c = [mpatches.Patch(color=CAT_COLORS[c], label=c) for c in categories]
p1990 = mpatches.Patch(facecolor="#999999", alpha=0.55, label="1990 (lighter)")
p2024 = mpatches.Patch(facecolor="#999999", alpha=1.0, label="2024 (solid)")
ax_c.legend(handles=leg_patches_c + [p1990, p2024], fontsize=8.5,
            loc="lower right", frameon=True, framealpha=0.9, ncol=5,
            edgecolor="#CCCCCC")

# ── Save ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=200, bbox_inches="tight",
            facecolor="white", edgecolor="none")
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")
